question: Which items and item order give Kog'Maw the most pressure from the first back, win mid-game fights, and reward skill? Win rate is context only.

wiki.note: Item infobox base stats (not the Masterwork column), pulled 2026-11-07. Where the wiki gives (melee / ranged) values, Kog uses the ranged one. Kog'Maw numbers are in data/kogmaw-adc-runes-aggro.json, pulled the same day.

kogR.missingHp: Damage +0 to 50% based on missing health, or +100% if the target is below 40% health (wiki, Living Artillery).
kogR.cost: 40 mana, +40 per stack for 8 s, up to 9 stacks

Guinsoo's Rageblade.wiki: Attacks deal 30 magic on-hit. Each attack: +8% AS for 4 s, up to 32%. At max stacks attacks build Phantom stacks; at 2, the next attack applies on-hit effects again after 0.15 s.

Blade of the Ruined King.wiki: Attacks deal 6% (ranged) of the target's current HP as physical on-hit. Every 3rd attack on a champion slows 30% for 1 s (15 s cooldown).

Terminus.wiki: Attacks deal 30 (+10% bonus AD, +10% AP) magic on-hit. Hits alternate Light (+6 to 8 armor and MR) and Dark (+10% armor and magic pen), 3 stacks each for 5 s.

Wit's End.wiki: Attacks deal 45 magic on-hit. 45 MR and 20% tenacity.

Kraken Slayer.wiki: Ranged: every 3rd attack deals 120 to 168 (level) bonus physical, up to +75% more against low-HP targets.

Runaan's Hurricane.wiki: Attacks fire bolts at up to 2 other enemies for 60% AD, applying on-hit. Adds nothing on a single target.

Navori Flickerblade.wiki: Each attack cuts the remaining cooldowns of Q, W and E by 15%.

Statikk Shiv.wiki: Energize: attacks give 15 charge (moving also charges). At 100 the next attack chains 60 magic to up to 8 targets.

Yun Tal Wildarrows.wiki: Ranged attacks build 0.2% crit each, up to 25% (125 attacks). First attack on a champion: +30% AS for 6 s (30 s cooldown).

Dusk and Dawn.wiki: Spellblade: after a spell, the next attack within 10 s deals 75% base AD (+10% AP) magic, heals 10% AP (+3% bonus HP), and applies on-hit effects again after 0.2 s. 1.5 s cooldown.

Lich Bane.wiki: Spellblade: after a spell, the next attack within 10 s gets +50% AS and deals 75% base AD (+45% AP) magic on-hit. 1.5 s cooldown.

Shadowflame.wiki: Magic and true damage crit for 120% against targets below 40% HP. 15 magic pen.

Stormsurge.wiki: Deal 25% of a champion's max HP within 2.5 s: 2 s later lightning hits for 125 (+10% AP) magic. 30 s cooldown.

Riftmaker.wiki: +2% damage per second in combat, up to 8%; then 6% omnivamp (ranged). AP equal to 2% bonus HP.

Luden's Echo.wiki: First spell hit: 75 (+5% AP) magic plus up to 90 to 150 more on a lone target. 12 s cooldown.

Liandry's Torment.wiki: Spell damage burns 6% max HP over 3 s. +2% damage per second in combat, up to 6%. Kog's W is on-hit, so only Q, E and R burn.

Jak'Sho, The Protean.wiki: After 5 s in combat: +30% bonus armor and MR.

Mercurial Scimitar.wiki: Active: cleanse all CC except airborne, 50% move speed for 2 s. 90 s cooldown.

Kaenic Rookern.wiki: Shield equal to 15% max HP against magic after 15 s without magic damage.

Hextech Alternator.wiki: 45 AP. First hit on a champion: 65 magic (40 s cooldown).

Sheen.wiki: Spellblade: after a spell, the next attack deals 100% base AD physical. 1.5 s cooldown.

Kircheis Shard.wiki: 15 AD. When Energized, the next attack deals 50 magic on-hit.

Scout's Slingshot.wiki: 20% AS. First hit on a champion: 40 magic (40 s cooldown, -1 s per attack).

context.note: Copied from the 'carry into fed assassins' page data (data/kogmaw-adc-vs-assassins.json): coachless.gg patch 16.21 and u.gg NA patch 26.21 (Riot 16.21), pulled 2026-11-07. 16.21 was the latest full patch; 16.22 had 705 NA Diamond+ Kog games on u.gg at the time, too few.
